departures.difference: Independent VGA-style replacement font rather than One-Nil private custom font
departures.reason: Reproducible new rendering without original font bytes; exact letterforms/width treatment remain a visual comparison point

departures.difference: Uniform scalable desktop surface with letterboxing
departures.reason: Retain original composition/information at documented viewport sizes; this does not establish final minimum window size or supported platform/DPI

departures.difference: Roster role cells use captured decoded aliases in replacement font
departures.reason: Original role font has custom glyphs not reliably mapped by CP437; do not treat aliases as a verified visual or semantic mapping

departures.difference: Independently drawn schematic player/ball markers at captured text-cell positions
departures.reason: Do not copy original sprites; these static quantized positions are not a native engine-coordinate or action-parity claim

limits: All player/score/statistic/clock displays are captured design content, not a new simulation or default career.
Original images are read for displayed colour observations only; proposed SVGs contain text/vector primitives and no embedded reference pixels.
Per-cell colour inference and replacement font may differ from original pixel-level glyph/background treatment; inspect side by side.
No changed screen order, control or transaction is approved by these static pictures.
This renderer uses a headless browser as an artifact tool; desktop remains the product and no GUI toolkit is selected.
